description: This file defines an Angular component named TraceViewComponent, responsible for rendering a trace viewing interface with tabs, overlays, and related UI controls for visualizing trace data in a web application.

classes.name: TraceViewComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for managing and displaying trace views with tab navigation and overlays, allowing interaction and trace data download.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes in input properties to re-render the view tabs and overlays.

methods.name: onTabClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on a tab, showing the selected tab.

methods.name: renderViewsTab
methods.description: Generates tab views from the connected viewers, sets additional properties, and initializes the first tab.

methods.name: renderViewsOverlay
methods.description: Adds overlay views' HTML elements into the overlay container, ensuring only one overlay is active.

methods.name: showTab
methods.description: Displays the selected tab, hides previous, and manages DOM attachment and visibility.

methods.name: isCurrentActiveTab
methods.description: Checks if a given tab is currently active.
